_base: Make one 16:9 video using the attached image as the exact first frame (image-to-video, Veo 3.1 Lite, 1 output, 8 seconds). Gentle, playful cartoon animation of this exact picture from my own game. STRICT RULES: only the characters already in the picture move; every character keeps exactly the same design, shape, colours and size and stays roughly in place; nobody new appears, nobody leaves, nothing turns into anything else; the camera stays still or pushes in very slowly. {X} No text, no speech or dialogue, no scene cut.
cut-open: Candle flames flicker, the golden spoon glows and twinkles, the three kaiju in front stay in place, slowly lick their lips, glance at each other with scheming grins, then look back at the spoon; the camera pushes in very slowly. Playful sneaky heist music.
cut-0: The crab kaiju snaps its claws grumpily twice and stomps its little feet on the roast chicken, steam curls up from the gravy boat. Comedic grumpy music with snip-snip sound effects.
cut-1: The octopus juggles the cutlery in a smooth loop with its tentacles, the green jelly blob wobbles and jiggles happily beside it. Bouncy comedic music with clinks and boings.
cut-2: The fridge light flickers softly, the toast bat sways upside down from the shelf and flaps its wings once, the marshmallow moth wiggles in the takeaway box and grins. Spooky-funny music and a fridge hum.
cut-3: The conveyor belt keeps rolling gently, the crowned sushi dragon smirks and waves one claw like a king, the salmon bodyguard crosses its fins and nods. Cool swaggering music.
cut-4: The elephant's pink bubblegum bubble slowly grows bigger and then pops with a splat, the chocolate golem freezes mid-bite with wide eyes and frosting on its cheeks, a little confetti flutters down. Silly party music with a pop sound.
cut-5: The pizza raptor and the avocado kaiju stare each other down, the raptor twirls its pizza cutter, the avocado narrows its eyes, a tiny tumbleweed-like crumb rolls between them. Dramatic standoff music with comedic timing.
cut-6: The muffin bear flips a pancake up and catches it in the pan, the griddle flames flicker, steam and sizzle rise, the crab and the toast bat at the counter tap impatiently. Sizzling sounds, a ding-ding order bell and fast diner jazz.
cut-7: The giant crowned jelly blob wobbles and glares, a little frost spreads on the counter, an ice cream scoop drips, the marshmallow moth peeks out from behind the milkshake and gulps. Ominous-but-silly boss music.
cut-8: The grape hound wags and bounces playfully with the paper plate, the ants keep marching in their line, the avocado and the salmon kaiju relax on the blanket, leaves sway in the breeze. Cheerful whistling summer music.
cut-9: The dumpling kaiju kneads and slaps the big ball of dough, little puffs of flour float up, the dough swells slightly, the muffin bear and chocolate golem watch nervously and blink. Thumping comedic villain music.
cut-10: The lazy Susan turns slowly round with the happy rice-ball baby gorilla giggling and clapping in the middle, the sushi dragon and bubblegum elephant sway dizzily. Merry-go-round music.
cut-11: The crowned dumpling boss grins smugly and raises the golden spoon, toast pops up from the toasters, the pizza raptor cracks its knuckles. Epic final-boss orchestral music with toaster pops.
cut-end: Confetti drifts down, the kaiju cheer and bounce in place, the golden spoon sparkles, the tall tower of dirty dishes wobbles and one plate slides off with a clang. Triumphant fanfare ending in a comedic sad trombone.
